modes.label: Gift or holiday timing
modes.description: A small linking word such as for, at, before or this that comes right before a holiday name or the holiday season.
modes.example: I purchased an “EyeFi” card for my sweetie<< for>> valentines day.

card.writes: It pushes the next word toward a holiday name or greeting, and away from Christmas and holiday words themselves.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or quote mark just before a holiday name like Christmas is about to appear.
